context: Sho tells Grandma about a surprise at school.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (再び/なんだか/びっくり/無駄/いきなり) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、いきなり雨が降ったよ!
lines.style: animated small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: まあ、びっくりしたでしょう。
lines.en: Oh my, you must've been startled.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、傘がなんだか役に立たなくて。
lines.en: Yeah, my umbrella was somehow useless.
lines.style: pouty small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 濡れちゃったの?無駄に走ったのね。
lines.en: Did you get wet? You ran for nothing.
lines.style: gentle grandmother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: でも、再び晴れてきたんだ!
lines.style: cheerful small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: なんだか、忙しいお天気ねぇ。
lines.en: Somehow, the weather's busy, isn't it.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm amused delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: いきなり虹も、出たんだよ!
lines.en: A rainbow suddenly came out too!
lines.style: delighted small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: それは、びっくりするほど綺麗ね。
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
